extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The UnitedHealthcare plan available in Orange County has a $5 monthly premium, a $385 drug deductible and a $6300 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent discussed plan benefits before the disclaimer, which is non-compliant. The call also involved the collection of personal information and scheduling an appointment.
composition.coaching_note: Grace should ensure the disclaimer is read before discussing plan benefits. Additionally, she should avoid collecting personal information like Medicare numbers and dates of birth during the initial call.

crm_record.next_step: Review and sign Scope of Appointment
